findings.finding: The release establishes an announced conditional acquisition agreement, not paid cash, a quantified current payable or final net closing cash.
findings.evidence: ezCater original HTML: opening acquisition paragraph, closing-conditions paragraph, and Forward-Looking Statements. The retained extract is text-consistent with the original.
findings.proposed_correction: None required. Preserve USD2.3bn as the stated all-cash transaction value and separately inventory the announced future capital use; require actual terms and settlement evidence for any cash/claim conclusion.
findings.outcome: Author treatment supported; current funding and entry remain parked.

findings.finding: June liquidity and earlier Q2 deployment cannot produce a current balance by subtracting the new stated transaction value. Separate target identity supports tracking, not an additive funded bill.
findings.evidence: Bound 12 October cash-context note identifies June USD5.4bn cash/cash equivalents/short-term investments, Q2 stake deployment, future Delivery Hero and AV commitments; new gate explicitly rejects synthetic USD3.1bn current cash and double subtraction.
findings.proposed_correction: None required for this scope. Retain period, overlap, restrictions and claim uncertainties; no independent acceptance of the older cash-context economics is implied.
findings.outcome: No normalized owner cash, aggregate current capital bill or funding sufficiency accepted.

findings.finding: Profitability on Non-GAAP Operating Income and expected margin accretion do not establish recurring per-share owner cash or value creation; closing in coming months supplies conditional timing, not a close date.
findings.evidence: ezCater original operating-metrics paragraph and closing-conditions paragraph; forward-looking caution identifies approval, closing-condition and synergy risks.
findings.proposed_correction: None required. Preserve management attribution and conditional timing; no return, synergy or funding forecast follows.
findings.outcome: Possible overlap with the stated days-to-months horizon is reasonable as a possibility only.

findings.finding: The retained recent SEC table and ten-item RSS support bounded discovery statements only. No later 8-K/10-Q, including amendments, was found in that table after 15 September through cutoff.

findings.outcome: Bounded absence wording accepted. Equality to the separate 12 October original remains an inherited capture-record assertion, not independently re-performed here.

findings.finding: The 5 October notice schedules a 4 November results call at 05:00 Pacific/08:00 Eastern; it does not establish the 10-Q filing date or future resolution of funding gaps.
findings.evidence: Call-notice original opening paragraph; no 10-Q filing-date assertion in inspected notice; full extracted non-whitespace text agrees with original.
findings.proposed_correction: None required. Preserve call-versus-filing distinction and avoid assuming the future release resolves funding.

findings.finding: The Gemini artifact is a selected quotation/summary and a reported UI reading, not a complete response, search log or independent proof of its source access/model backend.
findings.evidence: Bound Gemini assignment and selected-output record explicitly disclose selective retention, three-source assertion, baseline 8-A, and source-access limitations.

verdict.acceptance: Add conditional ezCater transaction to future capital-use inventory; retain actual-funding and entry park.
